mentions.name: Reposit
mentions.description: This platform lets users share a summary of the valuable learnings from an LLM chat for others to discover; agents can search it like Context7 for docs during problem research, learnings from open-source community projects are being added with attribution as seed content, and it can be self-hosted for private sharing within a company.
mentions.problem: Valuable learnings from back-and-forth LLM conversations get thrown away at the end of a chat, which feels wasteful.
mentions.source_excerpt: Having done a lot of back and forth with LLMs and at the end throwing away learnings from a conversation felt so wasteful - reposit allows you to /share a summary of the valuable learning from your LLM chat for others to discover.

evidence.value: Having done a lot of back and forth with LLMs and at the end throwing away learnings from a conversation felt so wasteful - reposit allows you to /share a summary of the valuable learning from your LLM chat for others to discover.
